text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE fired for team=eng-oncall severity=high — metric=queue_depth rising above 120k, autoscaler=behind, region=us-west-2. PD incident: PD-34821.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered PD-34821 — Capacity exhaustion detected: average queue growth 6k/s, 5xx spike +18% for hosted API.

alex: acking — oncall taking. Looking at autoscaler metrics and recent deploys.

priya: I see autoscaler heartbeats failing around 1759993000 -> 1759993300, kube API 429s in the controller logs. Could be quota/rate-limit.

lee_enginfra: @priya paste controller log snippet? I'll check provider quota and nodepool state.

priya: ```
  t=2025-02-14T18:02:21Z controller: reconcile loop failed: 429 Too Many Requests
  t=2025-02-14T18:02:22Z provider: request quota exceeded, status=403
  pending_scale_requests=3 desired_replicas=120 current_replicas=64
  queue_depth=124300 inflight=98 avg_latency=420ms
```

alex: hypothesis: autoscaler is queuing scale but provider returns quota errors -> never provisions new nodes -> backlog grows. Customer impact: a subset of requests to hosted-API are hitting 504/503 due to backend allocation delays.

jordan_cs: I'm seeing customer report: "latency and failures for embeddings batch jobs" — notifying top-10 affected customers, setting expectation.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) manual override -> increase desired replicas on hotnodepool to 200 (temp) 2) open emergency quota ticket with cloud provider 3) enable temporary ingress throttling for low-priority routes 4) warmup kv-cache after nodes join.

priya: doing (1) now: `kubectl patch nodepool hotpool --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"desired":200}}'` -> API returning 202 accepted but provider still showing quota=exceeded on create calls.

lee_enginfra: I've confirmed provider region quotas at limit. Can we shift some warmup capacity to us-east-1 or spin up smaller instances that fit remaining quota?

alex: spinning up fallback pool in us-east-1 with smaller instance type (g4dn.xsmall) as hotpatch. This will require model shard compatibility check. Priya, can you gate traffic once new nodes register?

priya: yes. Also starting a rolling canary to route 10% of new inference traffic to us-east fallback.

pagerduty: PD-34821: acknowledged by alex, escalation to oncall-lead scheduled in 5m if not resolved.

jordan_cs: I've sent interim email to affected customers: "We're mitigating capacity issues, expect partial service within 30-45 minutes."

alex: new nodes began provisioning at 1759993550, but we still see slow warmup due to KV cache coldstart. Triggering kv warmup: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'` to prefill prefixes.

priya: warmup requests in flight, monitoring queue drain. queue_depth -> 86k and decreasing. 5xx rate trending down.

lee_enginfra: provider confirmed quota increase request accepted on emergency channel; expected rate limit lift in ~12 minutes. Good to keep fallback pool live until then.

alex: traffic throttle: lowered concurrency for non-auth routes by 60% at edge, effective now. That freed capacity for high-priority customer traffic.

priya: queue at 32k, avg_latency 240ms, inflight 52. No new PD alerts.

pagerduty: PD-34821: status=investigating -> monitoring. No escalation.

jordan_cs: customers updated — will follow up after full recovery.

alex: Confirming manual steps to revert: once quota normal, we will 1) step down manual desired replicas to autoscaler-managed range 2) decommission fallback us-east pool 3) run post-incident eval for autoscaler backoff tuning and provider-rate-limit handling.

priya: creating follow-up ticket: INFRA-9123 (autoscaler: handle provider quota 403/429 with exponential backoff + alert).

lee_enginfra: recommend adding a predictive throttle rule in routing to avoid coldstart stampedes. Logging recommendations in INFRA-9123.

alex: resolving thread for now — queue steadily draining, customer impact reduced. Leaving PD open for final verification. Great work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update recorded: PD-34821 -> status=monitoring, incident-runbook=capacity-queue-backlog.

pagerduty: PD-34821: last_ack_by=alex at 1759993600, last_status_change=1759993700.

priya: last check: queue_depth=8,200, avg_latency=110ms, ingress errors back to baseline. Marking as mitigated.

alex: closing PD if we see stable metrics for 15m. If anything spikes, re-open thread.

jordan_cs: I'll prepare a short postmortem summary for customers and CSMs.

alex: thanks all — great coordination."
